interface.evidence: Original problem interface explicitly names clk, reset, q (4 bits).

semantics.clock: All sequential updates on positive edge of clk, per original problem.
semantics.reset: Active high synchronous: reset sampled high at a positive edge sets q to 0, overriding counting.
semantics.count: At each positive edge with reset low, legal state q advances through 0..9 and wraps from 9 to 0; period 10.
semantics.between_edges: q holds between positive edges, including reset transitions.
semantics.initialization: Original problem does not prescribe a power-up value; no initializer and no assertion of a particular pre-reset value.

numeric.wrap: Modulo ten on legal states; explicit 9-to-0 transition
numeric.constants: Four-bit sized literals; no rounding or saturation required

verification.oracle: Independent integer model derived from original decade sequence, advanced modulo 10 after sampled reset.
verification.sampling: Check after positive edge NBA updates and at negative edges; drive reset away from positive edge.
verification.coverage: Repeated complete decades; reset at each legal count including nine; held reset; reset pulse wholly between rising edges; no output changes at reset transitions.
verification.failure: $fatal on mismatch and bounded timeout; explicit PASS only at successful completion.

specification_ambiguities.resolution: Do not constrain q before first sampled synchronous reset.

specification_ambiguities.evidence: Only decade sequence 0 through 9 is specified
specification_ambiguities.resolution: No recovery requirement inferred or tested.
